raw_segments.text: One day, he remarked without lifting his head, in the interior you will no doubt meet Mr.
On my asking who Mr. Kurtz was, he said he was a first-class agent, and seeing my disappointment
at this information, he added slowly, laying down his pen, he is a very remarkable person.
Further questions elicited from him that Mr. Kurtz was at present in charge of a trading
post, a very important one, in the true ivory country, at the very bottom of there.
Sends in as much ivory as all the others put together.
The sick man was too ill to groan.
The flies buzzed in a great peace.
